CheckTitle: Not Allowed Resource Types policy is enabled
Description: Verify that Azure Policy restricts deployment of disallowed resource types.
Risk: Unrestricted resource types can lead to rogue deployments.

Code.Other:
1. Go to Azure Policy.
2. Assign 'Not allowed resource types' policy.
3. Specify the denied types.

Recommendation.Text: Review and implement the recommended configuration for Policy Ensure Not Allowed Resource Types Is Enabled.
